purpose: Specify the wearable biosensor that detects the molecule at the body surface (scalp, lumbar, or wrist).

specification.selectivity_ratio: >= 100x against common interferents (glucose, lactate, Na+, K+, Ca2+, urea, creatinine)
specification.power_consumption_mw: <= 5 (must run for 7+ days on a coin cell)

candidate_sensor_technologies.name: Electrochemical aptamer-based sensor
candidate_sensor_technologies.principle: Aptamer specific to molecule, immobilized on electrode, binding changes electron transfer
candidate_sensor_technologies.commercial_reference: Similar to existing continuous glucose monitors (Abbott Freestyle Libre uses glucose oxidase electrochemistry)
candidate_sensor_technologies.evidence_for: Highly selective. Tunable to any molecule by aptamer selection.
candidate_sensor_technologies.evidence_against: Aptamer selection is 6-12 month process per molecule. Chronic stability unproven for non-glucose targets.
candidate_sensor_technologies.status: PROMISING but requires per-molecule aptamer development

candidate_sensor_technologies.name: Optical fluorescence sensor
candidate_sensor_technologies.principle: If molecule is fluorescent, wearable LED + photodetector measures fluorescence through skin
candidate_sensor_technologies.evidence_for: Highly sensitive. Existing CGMs use similar optical approaches.
candidate_sensor_technologies.evidence_against: Requires molecule to be fluorescent (constrains step 1). Skin autofluorescence interferes.

candidate_sensor_technologies.name: Mass-sensitive (QCM, SAW)
candidate_sensor_technologies.principle: Molecule binds to surface, changes resonant frequency
candidate_sensor_technologies.evidence_against: Likely not sensitive enough at nM concentrations in complex biological matrix

candidate_sensor_technologies.name: Lateral flow (single-use)
candidate_sensor_technologies.principle: Capillary flow strip with antibody-antigen reaction
candidate_sensor_technologies.evidence_against: Single-use, not continuous. P-09 requires continuous monitoring.

what_unfreezes_this: Step 1 (molecule). Sensor selection depends on molecule properties (fluorescent? antigenic? electroactive?).
estimated_time_to_unblock: 6-12 months after molecule selected (aptamer development or optical sensor optimization)
